orgs.name: LATIN AMERICAN ASSOCIATION INC
services: Gwinnett County Coordinated Entry Assessment Center, operated in partnership with the Gwinnett County Board of Commissioners - the front door for people experiencing homelessness in Gwinnett County: assessments and pre-screening that route people to shelter and housing programs. It routes people to help; it does not pay rent itself
Gwinnett County sits in the Georgia Balance of State Continuum of Care (GA-501), administered by the Georgia Department of Community Affairs; LAA's Gwinnett page connects assessments into that system
LAA also runs a Lawrenceville Outreach Center (308 N Clayton St) for in-person help in the county seat
orgs.serves: people experiencing or at risk of homelessness in Gwinnett County
